title: Chameleon: Dynamic Format Adapter for Efficient Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2609.33496v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is the standard way to run modern diffusion models on memory-constrained accelerators, yet every existing diffusion PTQ scheme fixes the $\mathit{number\ format}$ in advance and only tunes the scale, zero point, or per-layer bit-width. At a fixed bit-width the best format depends on the distribution being encoded, and that distribution differs across weight channels, across layers, and along the diffusion timestep, where activation distributions slide from heavy-tailed and noise-dominated to tightly clustered and structured. translated_title: 变色龙：面向高效扩散模型的动态格式适配器
translated_abstract: 训练后量化（PTQ）是在内存受限的加速器上运行现代扩散模型的标准方法，然而现有所有的扩散模型PTQ方案都预先固定了数字格式，仅调整缩放因子、零点或逐层位宽。在固定位宽下，最佳格式取决于被编码的分布，而该分布在权重通道之间、层与层之间以及扩散时间步上都各不相同——激活分布会从重尾、噪声主导的形态逐渐演变为紧密聚集且结构化的形态。我们提出Chameleon，这是一个PTQ框架，它保持位宽固定，并将格式本身视为一个离散变量，按权重通道和激活层进行选择，并可选择按时间步分桶进一步细化。激活格式来自{INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}集合，基于两个低成本的统计量（经验峰度和闭式……[摘要在此处被截断]）提前选定。
tldr: Chameleon提出了一种混合格式的扩散模型训练后量化框架，在固定位宽的前提下将数字格式本身作为离散变量，按权重通道、激活层乃至扩散时间步自适应地选择INT8或FP8等格式，从而实现更高效的扩散模型推理。
en_tdlr: Chameleon is a mixed-format post-training quantization framework for diffusion models that treats the number format itself as a discrete variable, adaptively selected per weight channel, activation layer, and diffusion timestep bucket at fixed bit-width for more efficient diffusion inference.
